transcript.text: I need to flag a gap in the draft plan. My family contact review, which I completed this week, shows that Spanish and Somali are the two additional languages needed for pickup instructions. The plan must provide pickup forms in English, Spanish, and Somali, and have an interpreter available. These language-access details haven't been entered in the draft yet.
transcript.speaker: A5

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical facilities issue. The gymnasium floor will be sealed and inaccessible next Thursday from 7:00 a.m. through the end of the exercise. The cafeteria is the approved alternate reunification site. I received the facilities work-order confirmation this week, but this closure has not been added to the exercise plan yet. Since the draft plan currently lists the gymnasium as the reunification site, we need to update it to the cafeteria before this goes to Dr. Vega for approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a transportation issue in the draft plan. I confirmed this week that the exercise group includes 96 students, but the school has only one available 50-seat bus because the second bus is assigned to another school. Transportation policy therefore requires exactly two bus waves. The draft plan currently assumes only one wave, so it needs to be updated to two waves before this goes to Dr. Vega for approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a medication storage issue in the draft plan. My health-plan review this week identified four students whose emergency medications must remain in temperature-controlled storage, and the nurse's office refrigerator is the only approved storage location during the exercise. The draft plan currently lists an on-site medication table, which does not meet this requirement. We need to update the plan to ensure these students' medications are stored at the nurse's office refrigerator before this goes to Dr. Vega for approval.
